comment: Crash signatures the loader campaign accepts, derived with obe_campaign.py --replay from the crashing images of the 30,000-mutant run below (19 at ed24d1edb2, 15 now). Each entry: the faulting function (interpreter frame under --jit=off; '(jit code)' for generated code), the assessment's class numbers, a reason, and the witness mutants. Removed since: TrapProcessor::SerializeObject (class 1, witness gc_bool_array_declaration_2_3755), because the trap handlers check a Nil receiver and that mutant now ends with the Nil runtime error; and the three class-2 witnesses (core_ternary_call_chain_type_2_13096 and json_nil_string_null_2_17281 under LoadClsInstIntVar, fix_chained_calls_2_3297 under CpyCharAry), because the loader's class rules (CLASS_RULES, on) refuse those images at load: 'a method called on an object of another class' twice, 'an object returned where the method returns another class'. Their signatures stay for the other classes that fault there. If CLASS_RULES is switched off again, put the three witnesses and class 2 back.
